en.text:
<solar/>Daybreak Projectiles trigger a <solar/>Solar Ignition on hit. Ignitions from any source deal 100% increased damage.

Each enemy damaged by an <solar/>Ignition grants 40% Melee Ability Energy. <solar/>Scorched enemies grant 5% Melee Ability Energy per tick. 

<blue Solar Fulmination /> from the <blue Hunter's Journal Artifact /> doubles the Melee Ability Energy gained, and has its own damage doubled as well.

Does not increase <solar/>Scorch tick damage.
